candidate_rule: A Wisdom candidate is a compressed contextual inference from source-linked interpretations that survived the local counter-case gate. It is not source text, universal law, permission, or direct action authority.

candidates.name: Separate action-quality control from outcome ownership
candidates.principle: When an actor has a legitimate action within its role but cannot guarantee the result, evaluate and improve the controllable quality of action separately from psychological or ownership claims over the final outcome.
applies_when: outcome depends partly on external conditions
the actor can still monitor results and update from evidence
does_not_apply_as_authority_when: the active contract makes a result itself a required deliverable
the source batch is being used to resolve a broader duty conflict it does not cover

candidates.name: Do not let anticipated success or failure become the sole controller of action
candidates.principle: Success/failure expectations may inform planning, but should not become the sole arbiter of whether a legitimate action is worth executing; maintain a stable decision state while continuing to observe evidence.
applies_when: fear of failure or attraction to success is distorting a decision
the action remains legal, safe and role-consistent
feedback continues to influence future state
does_not_apply_as_authority_when: failure evidence indicates harm or invalidity
the action is blocked by permission, safety, dependency or capability
equanimity is being interpreted as emotional suppression or indifference

candidates.name: Action-focus must remain coupled to discernment, skill and feedback
candidates.principle: A principle favoring action over paralysis must not be reduced to blind execution; discernment, verification, failure feedback and skill remain part of competent action.
applies_when: an actor is tempted to confuse decisiveness with correctness
does_not_apply_as_authority_when: the action lacks permission or role authority
the action is unsafe or unqualified

global_guards: No candidate may overwrite source text or source claims.
No candidate may become law without a separate Law Formation Sequence.
No candidate may satisfy permission, resource, evidence or dependency thresholds by itself.
ASI-NODE-21 may govern application but may not manufacture source truth.
Actor View restrictions remain in force.
A later counter-case may supersede applicability through a new Sequence; it may not rewrite this closed source batch.
